sentences.text: It is not in dispute that the petitioner was working as Head 17:46:29 IST

Reason:
Master in Primary Shala at Jhanjhar, where 41 teachers were allegedly appointed without any authority.
The appointees included the family members/relatives of the petitioner.

3. Be that as it may, a departmental enquiry was held, in which the petitioner has been held guilty,
and consequently removed from service.
That order is under challenge at his instance before the High Court.
The petitioner, meanwhile, apprehending his arrest in the criminal case applied for anticipatory bail, which has been declined by the Courts below.
4. Having heard learned counsel for the petitioner and after taking into consideration all the attending circumstances, we do not find it a fit case to grant anticipatory bail.
The prayer to that effect is declined.

If the petitioner surrenders before the Trial Court and/or the Investigating Agency and thereafter applies for regular bail, such a prayer shall be considered as per its own merits without being influenced by the observations made in this order or by the Trial Court and the High Court, while declining anticipatory bail of the petitioner.
5.
The special leave petition is, accordingly, dismissed.
6. All pending applications, if any, also stand disposed of.

(ARJUN BISHT) (PREETHI T.C.)
ASTT.
